description: "Lash an enemy with flame, dealing |cffffff8342|r Flame Damage.\n\nActivating a different Dragonknight ability while in combat grants a stack of Seething Fury up to 3 times, increasing the damage of your next Molten Whip by |cffffff33|r% and your damage done by |cffffff5|r%, or |cffffff2|r% against players, for |cffffff10|r seconds. The damage done only activates if you are a Dragonknight."
